page.layout: One printed page, one column of text with citation paragraphs. Line numbers (5, 10, ... 35) stand in the left margin beside the column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature "Z" and catchword "Christi," at the foot. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.p: Gal.3.v.13. Christus nos redemit (ἐξηγόρασεν) ab execratione legis, dum pro nobis factus est execratio.
Et cap.4. verf.5. Postquam venit plenum tempus, emisit Deus filium suum, factum ex muliere, factum sub lege, ut eos, qui sub lege 5erant, redimeret (ἐξαγοράσῃ) ut adoptionem acciperemus.

Apoc.5.v.9.10. Dignus es, qui accipias librum & aperias sigilla eius: quoniam mactatus es, & redemisti (ἠγόρασας)[?] nos Deo per sanguinem tuum, ex omni tribu, & lingua & populo & natione; & fecisti nos Deo reges & sacerdotes: & regnabimus in terra.
10Coloss.1.v.13. Eruit (ἐῤῥύσατο) seu extraxit nos ex potestate tenebrarum.
Hebr.2.v.14.15. Ut per mortem aboleret eum, qui mortis habet imperium, hoc est, diabolum: Et liberos redderet, quotquot metu mortis per omnem vitam obnoxii erant servituti.

15Hinc Christus appellatur vindex, Job.19.v.25: liberator, Job.8.v.38. Gal.5.v.1: salvator & servator, Luc.2.v.11. Joh.4.v.42. Act.5.v.31. & 13.v.23. Phil.3.v.20. 2.Tim.1.v.10. Tit.1.v.10, 13. & 3.v.4.6. 2.Petri 1.v.1. & 2 v.20. & 3.v.2.18. 1.Joh.4.verf.14. Jud.v.25.
20Esa.53.v.10. Dominus delectatus conterere ipsum, morbo affecit, quandoquidem exponebat se ipse sacrificium pro reatu.
Eph.5.v.2. Christus dilexit nos & tradidit semetipsum pro nobis oblationem ac victimam Deo, in odorem bonae fragrantiae.
Hebr.9.v.14. Christus per spiritum æternum obtuli seipsum 25inculpatum Deo.
2.Cor.5.v.18. Deus reconciliavit nos sibi per Jesum Christum.
Hebræor.7. verf.22. Tanto melioris pacti sponsor factus est Jesus.
1.Cor.6.v.19.20. Non estis vestri juris. Nam pretio emti estis.
Matth.10.v.28. Filius hominis non venit, ut sibi ministretur, sed ut ministret, detq;[?] animam suam redemtionis pretium pro multis, λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν.
1.Tim.2.v.6. Qui (Christus Jesus) sese ipse dedit redemtio35nis pretium pro omnibus, ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων. Hoc pretium dicitur pretiosus sanguis agni inculpati & incontaminati Christi,

page.notes: Printed line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are in the left margin of the text and placed at their lines. Greek words are copied as far as legible; (ἠγόρασας), (ἐῤῥύσατο) and "detq;" in Matth. 10.28 are doubtful. The v/u and i/j spelling was normalised by rule (e.g. Ioh→Joh, Iesus→Jesus, vt→ut). Verse references are as printed. The blot over "Dignus" in Apoc. 5.9 is a stain and is not transcribed. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded.
